title: Most menu entries that move a companion's regard print the change up front (e.g. '(Vell +1)'), but a few don't: 'argue the covenant's terms (as a Scholar)' at the Keepers' Hall and 'swear to carry the covenant' at the Drowned Hall both moved Vell's regard afterward with no hint beforehand (the covenant oath only hinted its Crown-standing cost, not the approval).
where: The Keeper's Hall / 'argue the covenant's terms'; The Drowned Hall — the Covenant Chamber / 'swear to carry the covenant'
